damping_evidence.cross_solver_gate: No candidate is selected or called measured until an active QBlade binary discriminates the original and swapped SUBELEMENTS row order by paired decay.

acceptance_gates.row_order_discriminator: The original and swapped models must yield statistically/numerically separable decay rates consistent with one serialized candidate; otherwise active-binary damping semantics remain unresolved.

required_qblade_decay_probe.aerodynamics: off/vacuum if supported; otherwise zero inflow with aerodynamic-force channels checked negligible
required_qblade_decay_probe.excitation: one target at a time; apply the serialized 12-mode SVD force-dual column as a five-cycle narrowband Hann burst at the identified frequency, with complex real/imaginary coefficients implemented as harmonic quadratures, then set all 117 external-force rows exactly to zero
required_qblade_decay_probe.excitation_gate: The corresponding SVD evidence at that RPM must pass full-rank, condition-number, biorthogonality-residual, and off-target generalized-force gates before the decay is interpreted.
required_qblade_decay_probe.fit: Use a damped sinusoid only when the candidate is underdamped; for zeta>=1 fit the two real decay poles. Estimate frequency or poles and damping independently for every amplitude, time step, row order, RPM, and target mode.
required_qblade_decay_probe.optional_parser_control: A 20-column temporary row ending at documented DAMP may be added only as a parser control; it does not replace the original-versus-swapped pair.
paired_reference_models_before_any_corre: temporary swapped final-two-column row with every other byte-equivalent physical input held fixed
required_qblade_decay_probe.prohibition: Do not tune a candidate coefficient from this comparison and do not correct the tracked source row until the paired results are archived.
required_qblade_decay_probe.projection: Use the saved body-fixed 39-site complex action basis and rotate it consistently to the QBlade global frame at nonzero RPM; project with the matching force/displacement dual convention.
required_qblade_decay_probe.repeatability_requirement: After any runner, GXBeam, Julia, or modal-input change, regenerate an independent 0/1-RPM basis and reapply the selected-shape/force-dual cross-basis gates; do not reject an otherwise invariant target dual solely because a degenerate nuisance basis changes the raw full-matrix condition number.

damping_evidence.substructure_column_semantics_caveat: QBlade 2.0.9.7 documentation and archived 2.0.4 code use zero-based row[19] as DAMP and optional row[20] as drag, while the local reference header labels row[19] Drag and row[20] DAMP. Both source projections are retained without changing the reference row.
damping_evidence.type: unselected QBlade stiffness-proportional Rayleigh candidate coefficients projected by per-element undamped modal strain energy

external_action_mapping.method: component-local linear interpolation of the saved GXBeam point state in normalized QBlade body fraction; the eigenproblem mesh is unchanged

limitations: The modal basis is the converted OWENS/GXBeam structural model, not a QBlade/Chrono eigenvector export.
The positive-definite converted sectional mass convention intentionally differs from the indefinite literal QBlade Chrono construction documented by the converter.
Action-location values use component-fraction interpolation of the converted point state; they are not new eigenproblem nodes.
Every Rayleigh result is an unselected input-semantics candidate, not measured damping, and remains subject to the paired active-QBlade decay discriminator.
Aerodynamic damping, response-dependent lock-in, turbulent forcing, and nonlinear limit-cycle behavior are absent from this structural modal identification.

minimum_norm_force_duals.repeatability_interpretation: Individual vectors inside a degenerate zero-RPM cluster may rotate between eigensolves, so the raw 12-column condition number and bitwise CSV hashes are not invariants. Decay readiness is based on full rank/residual gates plus cross-regeneration invariance of the selected mode shapes, target force-dual columns, and their generalized-force action on the alternate basis.

svd_evidence_by_rpm.action_row_order: 39 sites in qblade_component/fraction order, global X then Y then Z
svd_evidence_by_rpm.complex_harmonic_convention: Phi^H F = I; real and imaginary force coefficients are the cosine and negative-sine harmonic quadratures
svd_evidence_by_rpm.real_reduction_policy: A purely real force dual may replace the complex harmonic dual only when every mode in the 12-mode basis passes the serialized action-shape real-scalar gate.

mode_state_convention.complex_quadratic_convention: Hermitian transpose; physical velocity states are used directly rather than inferred from lambda times displacement
mode_state_convention.mass_projection: m_q = (sum_e L v_e^H M_e_global v_e + sum_p v_p^H M_p_global v_p)/(omega^2 q_raw^2)
mode_state_convention.raw_vector: GXBeam first-order mixed right eigenvector from K v + lambda M v = 0
mode_state_convention.rayleigh_projection: c_q = (sum_e beta_e L f_e^H C_e f_e)/q_raw^2; zeta_q = c_q/(2 omega m_q)
mode_state_convention.serialized_element_fields_used_for_prope: Fi and Mi extracted by GXBeam.AssemblyState
mode_state_convention.serialized_point_fields: u, Wiener-Milenkovic theta, V, and Omega extracted by GXBeam.AssemblyState
